M.new = function(spec)
  spec = spec or {}
  local cfg = assert(spec.config, 'view_settle: 需要 spec.config')
  local L = assert(spec.layers, 'view_settle: 需要 spec.layers（view_layers）')
  local K = assert(spec.kit, 'view_settle: 需要 spec.kit（view_kit）')
  local THEME = assert(cfg.THEME, 'view_settle: config.THEME 必须是 THEME（= STYLE.chrome）')
  local MODE_THEME = cfg.MODE_THEME or {}
  local NUM = cfg.NUM or {}
  local PHONE = NUM.PHONE or {}
  local COPY = cfg.COPY or {}
  local SETTLE_OPT = cfg.SETTLE_OPT or {}

  -- 层名先过一遍 view_layers（层名写错当场报错，而不是渲染时静默按 hud 处理）
  for _, name in pairs(M.LAYER) do L.order(name) end

  local S = {}

  -- ===== 颜色工具（ARGB ↔ 通道；与 view_node.unpack / view_kit.C 同口径）=====
  local function parts(c)
    local v = c or 0
    if v < 0 then v = v + 4294967296 end
    return (v // 16777216) % 256, (v // 65536) % 256, (v // 256) % 256, v % 256
  end
  -- 任何颜色 → alpha=255 的不透明版（观感 = 压在 base 上的结果）。这是结构约束 C1。
  local function opaque(base, c)
    local a, r, g, b = parts(c)
    if a == 255 then return c end
    return K.over(base, K.C(255, r, g, b), a / 255)
  end

  -- MS.opts 的 mix：k>0 向白(255)靠，k<0 向墨(16)靠（第三档字色与三态色板用）
  local function mix(c, k)
    if not k or k == 0 then return c end
    local a, r0, g0, b0 = parts(c)
    local tt = (k > 0) and 255 or 16
    local kk = (k < 0) and -k or k
    local function ch(v)
      local n = math.floor(v + (tt - v) * kk + 0.5)
      if n < 0 then n = 0 end
      if n > 255 then n = 255 end
      return n
    end
    return K.C(a, ch(r0), ch(g0), ch(b0))
  end

  -- 文字框高：MS.opts 用 ⌊字号×1.5+6⌋（≥ view_kit.textMinH 的 1.45×+6 ⇒ 引擎不会 fits=false）
  local function textH(font) return math.floor(font * 1.5 + 6) end
  local function tagOf(id) return id:sub(1, 1):upper() .. id:sub(2) end

  -- ===== 选项声明（config 优先，缺项用兜底；两条分支 = 结构约束 C3）=====
  local function optionsOf(device)
    local decls = {}
    if device == 'mobile' then
      local acts = PHONE.actions
      if type(acts) ~= 'table' or #acts < 1 then acts = M.FALLBACK_PAD end
      for i = 1, #acts do
        local a = acts[i]
        local rank = a.rank or i
        decls[#decls + 1] = {
          id = a.act or M.OPT_IDS[rank] or M.OPT_IDS[i] or ('opt' .. i),
          key = a.key or 'R',
          label = a.label or '',
          rank = rank,
          prefix = false,             -- 手机端标签照抄 NUM.PHONE.actions（无 [R] 前缀）
        }
      end
    else
      local items = SETTLE_OPT.items
      if type(items) ~= 'table' or #items < 1 then items = M.FALLBACK_OPT end
      for i = 1, #items do
        local it = items[i]
        local rank = it.rank or i
        decls[#decls + 1] = {
          id = M.OPT_IDS[rank] or M.OPT_IDS[i] or ('opt' .. i),
          key = it.key or 'R',
          label = it.label or '',
          rank = rank,
          prefix = true,              -- MS.opts: '['..key..'] '..label
        }
      end
    end
    return decls
  end

  -- ===== 主入口：opts → node 数组 =====
  S.settle = function(opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local device = opts.device or 'pc'
    if device ~= 'pc' and device ~= 'mobile' then
      error("view_settle: opts.device 只认 'pc' / 'mobile'，收到 " .. tostring(device))
    end
    -- opts.style：选项的表现形态。'text' = 键位提示文字（PC 默认）；'pill' = 胶囊。
    -- 手机没有键盘 ⇒ 『只给文字』在触摸屏上不成立，device='mobile' 一律走胶囊（兜底，不随 style 变）。
    local style = opts.style
    if style ~= nil and style ~= 'auto' and style ~= 'pill' and style ~= 'text' then
      error("view_settle: opts.style 只认 'auto' / 'pill' / 'text'，收到 " .. tostring(style))
    end
    local variant = (device == 'mobile' or style == 'pill') and 'pill' or 'text'
    local mode = opts.mode or 'casual'
    local mt = MODE_THEME[mode] or MODE_THEME.casual or {}
    local accent = mt.accent or THEME.textMain
    local frame = mt.frame or THEME.gold
    local a = opts.alpha or 255                  -- 与 settleSetColors(a) 同口径（0..255 淡入）
    a = math.max(0, math.min(255, math.floor(a)))
    local canvas = opts.canvas or { 1600, 900 }
    local W, H = canvas[1] or 1600, canvas[2] or 900

    local cw = math.min(W - M.CARD.PADX, M.CARD.W)      -- layoutSettle
    local ch = opts.cardH or M.CARD.H                   -- 缺省 400（照抄现网）
    local cdy = (ch - M.CARD.H) / 2                     -- 卡高变了 ⇒ 卡内东西整体居中
    local cardBottom = -ch / 2
    local txtW = cw - M.TXT_INSET
    local wash = THEME.scrim or THEME.wall              -- 观感基准（C1 的预混底）

    local out = {}
    local function add(n) out[#out + 1] = n return n end

    -- ===== ① 遮罩（wash 层：只压暗，不参与选项）=====
    add {
      key = 'settleWash', name = 'settleWash', role = M.ROLE.scrim,
      layer = M.LAYER.wash, tpl = 'cell',
      pos = { 0, 0 }, size = { W + 60, H + 60 }, color = wash,
    }
    -- ===== ② 描边 + 面板 + 三条装饰带（panel 层）=====
    add {
      key = 'settleBorder', name = 'settleBorder', role = M.ROLE.shell,
      layer = M.LAYER.panel, tpl = 'cell',
      pos = { 0, 0 }, size = { cw + 8, ch + 8 }, color = opaque(wash, THEME.bezel),
    }
    add {
      key = 'settleCard', name = 'settleCard', role = M.ROLE.card,
      layer = M.LAYER.panel, tpl = 'cell',
      pos = { 0, 0 }, size = { cw, ch }, color = opaque(wash, THEME.panel),
    }
    for i = 1, #M.BARS do
      local b = M.BARS[i]
      local col = (b.color == 'frame') and frame or THEME.gold
      local by = (i == 1) and (ch / 2 - 3) or (b.y + cdy)   -- 顶条跟着卡顶，细带跟着内容
      add {
        key = 'settleBar' .. i, name = 'settleBar' .. i, role = M.ROLE.rule,
        layer = M.LAYER.panel, tpl = 'cell',
        pos = { 0, by }, size = { cw - b.inset, b.h }, color = opaque(wash, col),
      }
    end

    -- ===== ③ 五行卡内文字（card 层）——字号/框高/字色照 settleSetColors =====
    local noteText, noteColor
    if type(opts.note) == 'string' then
      noteText, noteColor = opts.note, opts.noteColor
    else
      local recs = COPY.settle
      if type(recs) ~= 'table' or #recs < 1 then recs = M.FALLBACK_NOTE end
      local idx = opts.noteIdx or 1
      local rec = recs[idx] or recs[1]
      if type(rec) == 'table' then
        noteText = (tostring(rec.text or ''):gsub('{lines}', tostring(opts.lines or 0)))
        noteColor = rec.color
      end
    end
    if type(noteText) ~= 'string' then noteText = '' end
    local noteRGB = M.NOTE_RGB_FALLBACK
    if noteColor ~= nil then
      local _, r0, g0, b0 = parts(noteColor)
      noteRGB = { r0, g0, b0 }
    end
    local function dk(k) return math.floor(a * k) end        -- settleSetColors 的三档 alpha
    local titleText = opts.title
    if type(titleText) ~= 'string' then
      if opts.win then
        titleText = M.WIN_TITLE[mode] or '你赢了！'
      else
        titleText = M.TITLE
      end
    end
    local texts = {
      { key = 'settleTitle', y = M.Y.title, font = M.FONT.title, h = M.H.title,
        text = titleText, color = K.C(dk(1), 185, 138, 60) },               -- 深金
      { key = 'settleScore', y = M.Y.score, font = M.FONT.score, h = M.H.score,
        text = '本局 ' .. tostring(opts.score or 0) .. ' 分',
        color = K.C(dk(1), 214, 126, 46) },                                 -- 暖橙
      { key = 'settleBest', y = M.Y.best, font = M.FONT.best, h = M.H.best,
        text = '最高 ' .. tostring(opts.best or 0), color = K.C(dk(1), 62, 74, 99) },
      { key = 'settleInfo', y = M.Y.info, font = M.FONT.info, h = M.H.info,
        text = '消行 ' .. tostring(opts.lines or 0) .. ' 行\u{3000}\u{3000}落块 '
          .. tostring(opts.pieceCount or 0) .. '\u{3000}\u{3000}等级 '
          .. tostring(opts.level or 1),
        color = K.C(dk(0.82), 124, 140, 168) },
      { key = 'settleNote', y = M.Y.note, font = M.FONT.note, h = M.H.note,
        text = noteText, color = K.C(dk(0.88), noteRGB[1], noteRGB[2], noteRGB[3]) },
    }
    for i = 1, #texts do
      local t = texts[i]
      local n = K.text {
        key = t.key, name = t.key, x = 0, y = t.y + cdy, w = txtW, h = t.h,
        text = t.text, font = t.font, color = t.color, layer = M.LAYER.card,
      }
      n.role = M.ROLE.cardText
      add(n)
    end

    -- ===== ④ 选项带（touch 层；行位置由卡矩形反解 = 结构约束 C2）=====
    local decls = optionsOf(device)
    local keys = opts.keyLabels or {}
    local row = {}
    local function push(n, id, group)
      n.opt, n.optId, n.optGroup = true, id, group
      row[#row + 1] = n
    end
    for i = 1, #decls do
      local d = decls[i]
      local cb = opts[M.CB[d.id] or '']
      local key = keys[d.id] or d.key
      local label = d.label
      if d.prefix then label = string.format(M.OPT_HINT_FMT, key, label) end
      local rank = d.rank
      local group = 'opt' .. i
      local t = tagOf(d.id)

      if variant == 'pill' then
        -- 胶囊：几何按设备取（手机 = NUM.PHONE，主键 ×1.15；PC = MS.opts variant P 三档），
        -- 配色两处共用 MS.opts 三档（全部不透明）；两端必须 circle 图元才是圆角。
        local w, h, font
        if device == 'mobile' then
          w = (rank == 1) and ((PHONE.ACT_W or M.ACT.W) * M.ACT.PRIMARY)
            or (PHONE.ACT_W or M.ACT.W)
          h = PHONE.ACT_H or M.ACT.H
          font = M.ACT.FONT
        else
          w = M.OPT_W[rank] or M.OPT_W[#M.OPT_W]
          h = M.OPT_H[rank] or M.OPT_H[#M.OPT_H]
          font = M.OPT_FONT[rank] or M.OPT_FONT[#M.OPT_FONT]
        end
        local pad = (rank == 3) and 5 or 7
        local rimColor = (rank == 3) and K.C(255, 214, 196, 158) or THEME.gold
        local fill, ink, kind
        if rank == 1 then
          fill, ink, kind = accent, K.C(255, 255, 255, 255), 'fill'
        elseif rank == 2 then
          fill, ink, kind = THEME.card, THEME.textMain, 'line'
        else
          fill, ink, kind = K.C(255, 250, 245, 238), mix(THEME.textMain, 0.30), 'flat'
        end
        local rimCol, fillCol = opaque(wash, rimColor), opaque(wash, fill)
        -- 标签控件名：PC 用 tests/37 契约 optT1..3；手机用 settleLabel*
        -- （刻意避开现网 pad 的 pta*/pba*/pea* 家族 ⇒ 见测试 F1「pad 通道复发」守卫）
        local labelKey = (device == 'mobile') and ('settleLabel' .. t) or ('optT' .. i)
        local nodes = K.pill {
          key = 'settleRim' .. t, x = 0, y = 0, w = w + pad, h = h + pad,
          color = rimCol, layer = M.LAYER.touch, capShape = 'circle',
        }
        for k = 1, #nodes do
          nodes[k].role = M.ROLE.capRim
          push(nodes[k], d.id, group)
        end
        nodes = K.pill {
          key = 'settleCap' .. t, x = 0, y = 0, w = w, h = h,
          color = fillCol, layer = M.LAYER.touch, capShape = 'circle',
        }
        for k = 1, #nodes do
          local n = nodes[k]
          n.role = M.ROLE.capFill
          -- 三态色板：照 MS.opts paint() 的 mix 系数（接线方可用；render.lua 目前不读）
          n.state = {
            kind = kind,
            hoverK = (kind == 'fill') and -0.13 or (kind == 'line') and 0.78 or 0.04,
            pressK = (kind == 'fill') and -0.26 or (kind == 'line') and 0.60 or -0.10,
            rimHoverK = 0.10, rimPressK = -0.34, dy = -3,
          }
          push(n, d.id, group)
        end
        local lb = K.text {
          key = labelKey, name = labelKey, x = 0, y = -1, w = w - 8, h = textH(font),
          text = label, font = font, color = ink, layer = M.LAYER.touch,
        }
        lb.role = M.ROLE.capLabel
        push(lb, d.id, group)
        local hit = K.hit {
          key = 'hit' .. t, name = 'hotSettle' .. key, x = 0, y = 0,
          w = w + M.HITPAD, h = h + M.HITPAD, layer = M.LAYER.touch,
          on = cb and { CursorClick = cb } or nil,
        }
        hit.role = M.ROLE.hit
        hit.hitKey = key
        push(hit, d.id, group)
      else
        -- PC：只出键位提示文字（无胶囊 = 结构约束 C3）+ 透明热区（鼠标仍可点）
        local w = M.OPT_W[rank] or M.OPT_W[#M.OPT_W]
        local font = M.OPT_FONT[rank] or M.OPT_FONT[#M.OPT_FONT]
        local ink = (rank == 1) and K.C(255, 62, 74, 99)
          or (rank == 2) and (THEME.textDim or K.C(255, 82, 97, 107))
          or (THEME.hint or K.C(255, 96, 126, 152))
        local h = textH(font)
        local tn = K.text {
          key = 'optT' .. i, name = 'optT' .. i, x = 0, y = 0, w = w, h = h,
          text = label, font = font, color = ink, layer = M.LAYER.card,
        }
        tn.role = M.ROLE.hint
        push(tn, d.id, group)
        local hit = K.hit {
          key = 'hit' .. t, name = 'hotSettle' .. key, x = 0, y = 0,
          w = w + M.HITPAD, h = h + M.HITPAD, layer = M.LAYER.touch,
          on = cb and { CursorClick = cb } or nil,
        }
        hit.role = M.ROLE.hit
        hit.hitKey = key
        push(hit, d.id, group)
      end
    end

    -- 水平：按 optGroup 聚合（组宽取该组最宽节点 = 热区），居中排一行，净距 OPT_GAP
    local groups, groupW = {}, {}
    for i = 1, #row do
      local n = row[i]
      local g = n.optGroup
      if groupW[g] == nil then
        groups[#groups + 1] = g
        groupW[g] = 0
      end
      local w = (n.size and n.size[1]) or 0
      if w > groupW[g] then groupW[g] = w end
    end
    local total = 0
    for g = 1, #groups do total = total + groupW[groups[g]] end
    total = total + M.OPT_GAP * (#groups - 1)
    local cursor = -total / 2
    local cx = {}
    for g = 1, #groups do
      local gw = groupW[groups[g]]
      cx[groups[g]] = cursor + gw / 2
      cursor = cursor + gw + M.OPT_GAP
    end
    -- 垂直：行内最高节点（含热区）的顶边贴到「卡底 - ROW_GAP」
    local rowTop = 0
    for i = 1, #row do
      local n = row[i]
      local top = (n.pos[2] or 0) + ((n.size and n.size[2]) or 0) / 2
      if top > rowTop then rowTop = top end
    end
    local rowY = cardBottom - M.ROW_GAP - rowTop
    for i = 1, #row do
      local n = row[i]
      n.pos[1] = (n.pos[1] or 0) + (cx[n.optGroup] or 0)
      n.pos[2] = (n.pos[2] or 0) + rowY
      add(n)
    end

    return out
  end

  return S
end

return M

    local out = {}
    local function add(n)
      n.seq = #out + 1
      out[#out + 1] = n
      return n
    end
    -- 图元节点：**每个都显式带 image**（不靠模板默认 ⇒ headless 可断言 imageId）
    local function shape(key, role, layer, x, y, w, h, color, sh, rot)
      return add {
        key = key, name = key, role = role, layer = layer, tpl = 'cell',
        pos = { x, y }, size = { w, h }, color = color,
        image = { s = sh or 'rect' }, rot = rot,
      }
    end
    local function txt(key, role, layer, str, x, y, w, h, font, color, align)
      local n = K.text {
        key = key, name = key, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, text = str or '',
        font = font, color = color, bg = 0, align = align or 'Middle', valign = 'Middle',
        layer = layer,
      }
      n.role = role
      return add(n)
    end
    -- 胶囊（view_kit.pill = 中段 rect + 左右 circle 端点；端点必须 circle 才是圆角）
    local function pill(key, role, layer, x, y, w, h, color)
      local nodes = K.pill { key = key, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, color = color,
        layer = layer, capShape = 'circle' }
      for i = 1, #nodes do
        nodes[i].role = role
        add(nodes[i])
      end
      return nodes
    end
    local function hit(key, x, y, w, h, cursors, on)
      return add {
        key = key, name = key, role = M.ROLE.hit, layer = M.LAYER.hit, tpl = 'hit',
        pos = { x, y }, size = { w, h }, cursor = cursors, on = on,
      }
    end
    local function cb(fn, i)
      if not fn then return nil end
      return function() fn(i) end
    end
    -- 单事件回调表（on 必须是 { 事件名 = fn } 的映射，不是裸函数；render 按 cursor 表逐项查）
    local function clickOnly(fn)
      if not fn then return nil end
      return { CursorClick = fn }
    end

    -- ===== ① 展台（stage.on=false 时整块不出）=====
    if stageOn then
      local ST = M.STAGE
      local winHalf, winTop, winBot = ST.winHalf, ST.winTop, ST.winBot
      local sideW = halfW - winHalf
      local sideH = winTop - winBot
      local sideCY = (winTop + winBot) / 2
      -- 四面深空墙：只留中央视窗（+overscan 遮住画布边缘缝）
      shape('menuWallL', M.ROLE.wall, M.LAYER.stage, -(winHalf + sideW / 2), sideCY,
        sideW, sideH, wall)
      shape('menuWallR', M.ROLE.wall, M.LAYER.stage, winHalf + sideW / 2, sideCY,
        sideW, sideH, wall)
      shape('menuWallT', M.ROLE.wall, M.LAYER.stage, 0, (halfH + winTop) / 2,
        W + ST.wallOverscan, halfH - winTop + 1, wall)
      shape('menuWallB', M.ROLE.wall, M.LAYER.stage, 0, (winBot - halfH) / 2,
        W + ST.wallOverscan, halfH + winBot + 1, wall)
      -- 顶部/底部云带（比墙深一档）
      shape('menuSkyT', M.ROLE.sky, M.LAYER.stage, 0, halfH - ST.skyT.dy,
        W + ST.skyOverscan, ST.skyT.h, wallAlt)
      shape('menuSkyB', M.ROLE.sky, M.LAYER.stage, 0, -halfH + ST.skyB.dy,
        W + ST.skyOverscan, ST.skyB.h, wallAlt)
      -- 装饰（云 / 星芒 / 花瓣 / 光点）：config.THEME.deco 的 spec 流，逐条预混后出节点
      local deco = THEME.deco or {}
      for i = 1, #deco do
        local d = deco[i] or {}
        shape('menuDeco' .. i, M.ROLE.deco, M.LAYER.stage, d.x or 0, d.y or 0,
          d.w or 0, d.h or 0, opaque(wall, d.c), d.s, d.rot)
      end
      -- 视窗内阴影（贴边内外各 10）：现网 alpha 26 直接贴 ⇒ 这里预混成不透明
      shape('menuShadeT', M.ROLE.shade, M.LAYER.stage, 0, winTop - ST.shade.out,
        2 * winHalf + ST.shade.pad, ST.shade.w, shadeC)
      shape('menuShadeB', M.ROLE.shade, M.LAYER.stage, 0, winBot + ST.shade.out,
        2 * winHalf + ST.shade.pad, ST.shade.w, shadeC)
      shape('menuShadeL', M.ROLE.shade, M.LAYER.stage, -winHalf - ST.shade.out, sideCY,
        ST.shade.w, sideH + 8, shadeC)
      shape('menuShadeR', M.ROLE.shade, M.LAYER.stage, winHalf + ST.shade.out, sideCY,
        ST.shade.w, sideH + 8, shadeC)
      -- 描金细边（四条）
      shape('menuBezelT', M.ROLE.bezel, M.LAYER.stage, 0, winTop,
        2 * winHalf + ST.bezel.pad, ST.bezel.h, bezelC)
      shape('menuBezelB', M.ROLE.bezel, M.LAYER.stage, 0, winBot,
        2 * winHalf + ST.bezel.pad, ST.bezel.h, bezelC)
      shape('menuBezelL', M.ROLE.bezel, M.LAYER.stage, -winHalf, sideCY,
        ST.bezel.h, sideH + 8, bezelC)
      shape('menuBezelR', M.ROLE.bezel, M.LAYER.stage, winHalf, sideCY,
        ST.bezel.h, sideH + 8, bezelC)
      -- 四角括号（画布四角，各两条）
      local arm, thick, inset = ST.corner.arm, ST.corner.thick, ST.corner.inset
      for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
        for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
          local tag = (sx > 0 and 'R' or 'L') .. (sy > 0 and 'T' or 'B')
          shape('menuTickH' .. tag, M.ROLE.tick, M.LAYER.stage, sx * (halfW - arm / 2 - inset),
            sy * (halfH - inset), arm, thick, tickC)
          shape('menuTickV' .. tag, M.ROLE.tick, M.LAYER.stage, sx * (halfW - inset),
            sy * (halfH - arm / 2 - inset), thick, arm, tickC)
        end
      end

      -- ===== ② 标题横幅 + 大字（hud 层：压在展台墙上）=====
      local BN = M.BANNER
      local titleSize = (halfH > BN.hthr) and BN.fsWide or BN.fsNarrow
      local titleY = math.min(winTop + (halfH - winTop) * BN.yMid + BN.yDy, halfH - BN.yTopInset)
      local bannerH = titleSize + BN.hPad
      pill('menuBanner', M.ROLE.banner, M.LAYER.hud, 0, titleY, BN.w, bannerH,
        K.over(wall, gold, 0.34))
      shape('menuBannerRule', M.ROLE.rule, M.LAYER.hud, 0, titleY - bannerH / 2 + BN.ruleDy,
        BN.ruleW, BN.ruleH, goldDeep)
      -- 大字：常态 = 游戏名（可被 stage.title 覆盖）；stage.mode ⇒ MS.focusLock 的模式名大字
      local bigText = (type(stageOpt.title) == 'string') and stageOpt.title or BN.bigDefault
      local bigFs, bigW, bigH = titleSize, BN.bigW, math.floor(titleSize * 1.45 + BN.bigHPad)
      local bigY, bigColor = titleY, goldDeep
      if stageOpt.mode ~= nil then
        local idx = indexOf(stageOpt.mode)
        local info = idx and MODE_INFO[idx] or nil
        bigText = MODE_TITLE[stageOpt.mode] or tostring(stageOpt.mode)
        bigFs, bigH = BN.focusFs, BN.focusH
        bigW, bigY = BN.focusW, 0
        bigColor = (info and info.colorDeep) or ink
      end
      txt('menuBig', M.ROLE.big, M.LAYER.hud, bigText, 0, bigY, bigW, bigH, bigFs, bigColor)

      -- ===== ③ 底部提示条（三段 + 两个分隔点）=====
      local lineY = -(halfH - M.HINT.dy)
      local hints = opts.hints
      for i = 1, #M.HINT.segs do
        local seg = M.HINT.segs[i]
        local txtStr = (type(hints) == 'table' and type(hints[i]) == 'string')
          and hints[i] or seg.text
        txt('menuHint' .. i, M.ROLE.hint, M.LAYER.hud, txtStr, seg.x, lineY, seg.w,
          M.HINT.h, M.HINT.font, ink)
      end
      shape('menuDot1', M.ROLE.dot, M.LAYER.hud, -M.HINT.dotX, lineY, M.HINT.dotD,
        M.HINT.dotD, gold)
      shape('menuDot2', M.ROLE.dot, M.LAYER.hud, M.HINT.dotX, lineY, M.HINT.dotD,
        M.HINT.dotD, gold)

      -- ===== ④ 版本水印（画布右下）+ 品牌标（画布左上）=====
      local tag = opts.buildTag or M.TAG.text
      if tag ~= '' then
        txt('menuBuildTag', M.ROLE.tag, M.LAYER.hud, tag, W / 2 - M.TAG.xInset,
          -(H / 2 - M.TAG.yInset), M.TAG.w, M.TAG.h, M.TAG.font, subInk)
      end
      txt('menuSub', M.ROLE.sub, M.LAYER.hud, M.SUB.text, -(W / 2 - M.SUB.xInset),
        H / 2 - M.SUB.yInset, M.SUB.w, M.SUB.h, M.SUB.font, subInk, 'Left')

      -- ===== ⑤ 旅行者手记（一行；轮播是状态）=====
      local noteText, noteColor = opts.note, opts.noteColor
      if type(noteText) ~= 'string' then
        local recs = COPY.title
        if type(recs) == 'table' and #recs > 0 then
          local idx = opts.noteIdx or 1
          local rec = recs[idx] or recs[1]
          if type(rec) == 'table' then
            noteText, noteColor = rec.text, rec.color
          end
        end
      end
      if type(noteText) == 'string' and noteText ~= '' then
        local cc = noteColor or subInk
        if opts.noteAlpha ~= nil then
          local _, r, g, b = parts(cc)
          local a = math.max(0, math.min(255, math.floor(opts.noteAlpha)))
          cc = K.C(a, r, g, b)
        end
        txt('menuNote', M.ROLE.note, M.LAYER.hud, noteText, M.NOTE.x, M.NOTE.y,
          M.NOTE.w, M.NOTE.h, M.NOTE.font, cc)
      end
    end

    -- ===== ⑥ 四张模式卡（card 层：压在展台墙与横幅之上）=====
    local modes = opts.modes
    if type(modes) ~= 'table' or #modes < 1 then modes = MODE_INFO end
    if type(modes) ~= 'table' or #modes < 1 then modes = M.FALLBACK_MODES end
    local cardCount = #modes
    if cardCount > #M.CARD.rows then cardCount = #M.CARD.rows end

    local activeIdx = indexOf(opts.active)
    local hoverIdx = indexOf(opts.hover)
    local pressIdx = indexOf(opts.pressed)
    local function stateOf(i)
      if pressIdx == i then return 'press' end
      if hoverIdx == i then return 'hover' end
      if activeIdx == i then return 'select' end
      return 'normal'
    end

    local CD = M.CARD
    for i = 1, cardCount do
      local m = modes[i] or {}
      local cx, cy = CD.rows[i][1], CD.rows[i][2]
      local st = stateOf(i)
      local dy = CD.dy[st]
      local base = m.color or gold
      local fill = K.over(wall, base, CD.fillK[st])
      local beadD = CD.beadD[st]
      -- 胶囊三块（中段矩形 + 两端圆）：三态只换色与整体位移
      local nodes = pill('menuPill' .. i, M.ROLE.cardBg, M.LAYER.card, cx + CD.pillDx,
        cy + dy, CD.pillW, CD.pillH, fill)
      -- 三态色板随节点带出（render 目前不读，接线方要手动画过渡时可用；与 view_settle 同口径）
      for k = 1, #nodes do
        nodes[k].state = { kind = 'fill', fillK = CD.fillK, dy = CD.dy, cur = st }
      end
      -- 元素宝珠（实心圆）+ 内环（ring 图元，浅色内圈）
      shape('menuBead' .. i, M.ROLE.bead, M.LAYER.card, cx + CD.beadDx, cy + dy,
        beadD, beadD, (stateOf(i) == 'normal') and base or ((m.colorDeep) or base), 'circle')
      local ringD = math.floor(beadD * CD.ringRatio + 0.5)
      shape('menuRing' .. i, M.ROLE.ring, M.LAYER.card, cx + CD.beadDx, cy + dy,
        ringD, ringD, K.over(fill, K.C(255, 255, 255, 255), CD.ringLight), 'ring')
      -- 星芒（fourstar；alpha 由三态决定，预混在胶囊底色上）
      shape('menuStar' .. i, M.ROLE.star, M.LAYER.card, cx + CD.starDx, cy + dy,
        CD.starD, CD.starD,
        opaque(fill, K.C(CD.starA[st], (base // 16777216) % 256,
          (base // 65536) % 256, (base // 256) % 256)), 'fourstar')
      -- 标题（键位数字 + 模式名，左对齐）与特色句
      local hot = (st ~= 'normal')
      txt('menuTitle' .. i, M.ROLE.cardTitle, M.LAYER.card,
        tostring(m.key or '') .. '  ' .. tostring(m.name or ''), cx + CD.titleDx,
        cy + dy + CD.titleDy, CD.titleW, CD.titleH, CD.titleFs[st],
        hot and ((m.colorDeep) or ink) or ink, 'Left')
      txt('menuDesc' .. i, M.ROLE.cardDesc, M.LAYER.card, tostring(m.desc or ''),
        cx + CD.titleDx, cy + dy + CD.descDy, CD.descW, CD.descH, CD.descFs,
        hot and ink or subInk, 'Left')
      -- 透明命中热区（现网 menuZone i：胶囊 +16/+8；热区不随三态位移）
      local on = {
        CursorDown = cb(opts.onPick, i),
        CursorClick = cb(opts.onConfirm, i),
      }
      if on.CursorDown == nil and on.CursorClick == nil then on = nil end
      hit('menuZone' .. i, cx + CD.pillDx, cy, CD.hitW, CD.hitH,
        { 'CursorDown', 'CursorClick' }, on)
    end

    -- ===== ⑦ 两张入口卡（角色档案 / 说明，card 层）=====
    local EN = M.ENTRY
    local ex = math.min(EN.exMax, halfW - EN.exInset)
    local ey = (device == 'mobile') and (halfH - EN.eyMobileInset) or EN.eyPc
    local hx = ex + EN.helpDx
    local entryFill = K.over(wall, gold, 0.12)      -- controls.lua PRESET.gold.base

    local r = EN.roster
    pill('menuEntryRoster', M.ROLE.entryBg, M.LAYER.card, ex, ey, r.w, r.h, entryFill)
    txt('menuEntryRosterT', M.ROLE.entryTitle, M.LAYER.card, r.label, ex, ey + r.titleDy,
      r.w - r.pad * 2, hOf(r.fs), r.fs, goldDeep)
    txt('menuEntryRosterS', M.ROLE.entrySub, M.LAYER.card,
      (device == 'mobile') and r.subMobile or r.subPc, ex, ey - r.subDy,
      r.w - r.padSub * 2, hOf(r.subFs), r.subFs, subInk)
    for i = 1, #EN.dots do
      local d = EN.dots[i]
      shape('menuEntryDot' .. i, M.ROLE.entryDot, M.LAYER.card,
        ex + EN.dotDx + (i - 1) * EN.dotStep, ey + EN.dotDy, EN.dotD, EN.dotD,
        C(255, d[1], d[2], d[3]), 'circle')
    end

    local hp = EN.help
    pill('menuEntryHelp', M.ROLE.entryBg, M.LAYER.card, hx, ey, hp.w, hp.h, entryFill)
    txt('menuEntryHelpT', M.ROLE.entryTitle, M.LAYER.card, hp.label, hx, ey + hp.titleDy,
      hp.w - hp.pad * 2, hOf(hp.fs), hp.fs, goldDeep)
    txt('menuEntryHelpS', M.ROLE.entrySub, M.LAYER.card,
      (device == 'mobile') and hp.subMobile or hp.subPc, hx, ey - hp.subDy,
      hp.w - hp.padSub * 2, hOf(hp.subFs), hp.subFs, subInk)

    -- ===== ⑧ 热区（touch 层：永远最上）=====
    hit('menuRosterZone', ex, ey, r.w + EN.hitPadW, r.h + EN.hitPadH, { 'CursorClick' },
      clickOnly(opts.onRoster))
    hit('menuHelpZone', hx, ey, hp.w + EN.hitPadW, hp.h + EN.hitPadH, { 'CursorClick' },
      clickOnly(opts.onHelp))
    -- 底部提示条第三段「H 游戏说明」本身也是鼠标入口（现网 MS.buildHoverZones 的 menuHelpZone）
    if stageOn then
      hit('menuHintZone', M.HINT.segs[3].x, -(halfH - M.HINT.dy), 260, 56,
        { 'CursorClick' }, clickOnly(opts.onHelp))
    end

    -- 展台「在但声明不可见」：只落 visible 字段（真隐藏请用 stage.on=false）
    if stageOn and not stageVisible then
      local stageHud = L.order(M.LAYER.hud)
      for i = 1, #out do
        local ln = out[i]
        if L.order(ln.layer) <= stageHud then ln.visible = false end
      end
    end

    return out
  end

  -- 便捷：某设备/画布/状态下的节点数（接线方给 `menu cards n=` 之类的日志读数用）
  S.count = function(opts)
    return #S.title(opts or {})
  end

  return S
end

return M

--[[==========================================================================
tetris/widgets.lua —— 控件工具箱（保护式读写 / 光标事件 / 按名取控件 / 模板探测）
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
为什么要单独一个模块（v2.7 ⑨ 拆分）：真机上某些字段/方法会抛错、某些键名不存在
（2026-10-24 实证：一处抛错中断整段 OnStart ⇒ 全部按键无响应），所以所有控件读写都要过
pcall 护栏 —— 这套护栏全工程只该有一份；且这些函数只依赖「root + game」，与棋盘状态无关。
契约（docs/research/lua-module-contract.md）：本文件**未挂载、只被 require**；chunk 在 OnInit
阶段执行 ⇒ 顶层不许实例化控件；`script` 在模块里是 dummy ⇒ root/game/样式都由 main 注入。
  spec = { game, rootOf = function() -> root, styleOf = function() -> UI_STYLE }
=========================================================================]]

local M = {}

M.new = function(spec)
  local game = spec.game
  local rootOf = spec.rootOf or function() return nil end
  local function styleTable()
    local f = spec.styleOf
    local t = f and f() or spec.style
    return t or {}
  end

local FAILED = {}
local function noteFail(tag, err)
  if FAILED[tag] then return end
  FAILED[tag] = true
  print('ui fail ' .. tag .. ' :: ' .. tostring(err))
end
local function trySet(ctl, key, value)
  if not ctl then return false end
  -- 真机适配（v2.2）：对齐字段真机要枚举不收字符串（真机日志 `bad argument #2
  -- (TextHorizontalAlignment expected, got string)`——模拟器两形态都收）。先映射枚举，
  -- 无 Enum 表回落字符串。
  if (key == 'horizontalAlignment' or key == 'verticalAlignment') and type(value) == 'string' then
    local enums = (type(Enum) == 'table')
      and ((key == 'horizontalAlignment' and Enum.TextHorizontalAlignment) or Enum.TextVerticalAlignment)
      or nil
    if enums and enums[value] ~= nil then value = enums[value] end
  end
  local ok, err = pcall(function() ctl[key] = value end)
  if not ok then noteFail(tostring(key), err) return false end
  return true
end
local function tryCall(ctl, method, a, b)
  if not ctl then return false end
  -- 真机适配（v2.2）：方法签名严格——SetVisible 真机 2 expected got 3（尾 nil 实参也计数）。
  -- 按实参个数分发：b/a 为 nil 不传。模拟器宽松两形态都过。
  local ok, err
  if b ~= nil then
    ok, err = pcall(function() ctl[method](ctl, a, b) end)
  elseif a ~= nil then
    ok, err = pcall(function() ctl[method](ctl, a) end)
  else
    ok, err = pcall(function() ctl[method](ctl) end)
  end
  if not ok then noteFail(tostring(method), err) return false end
  return true
end

-- 光标事件注册（v2.7 抽出公用）：真机 CursorEventType 要**枚举值**，模拟器接受字符串。
-- 与按键监听同一套双形态探测（见 OnStart 的 listen）：先枚举，失败回落字符串。
-- 返回是否注册成功，并在失败时打日志（真机不认某事件也不该中断整段 OnStart）。
local function addCursor(ctl, kindName, fn)
  if not ctl then return false end
  local enumT = (type(Enum) == 'table' and Enum.CursorEventType) or nil
  local ev = enumT and enumT[kindName] or nil
  local ok, err
  if ev ~= nil then
    ok, err = pcall(function() ctl:AddCursorEventListener(ev, fn) end)
  end
  if not ok then
    ok, err = pcall(function() ctl:AddCursorEventListener(kindName, fn) end)
  end
  if not ok then
    print('cursor listen fail ' .. tostring(kindName) .. ' :: ' .. tostring(err))
    return false
  end
  return true
end

local function find(name)
  local root = rootOf()
  if not root then return nil end
  local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return root:GetChild(name) end)
  if ok then return ctl end
  return nil
end

local function setText(ctl, value)
  if ctl then trySet(ctl, 'text', value) end
end

local function applyStyle(name, ctl)
  local st = styleTable()[name]        -- 惰性取样式表（main 的 UI_STYLE 定义在本模块装载之后）
  if not ctl or not st then return end
  if st.font then trySet(ctl, 'fontSize', st.font) end
  if st.color then trySet(ctl, 'fontColor', st.color) end
  if st.bg then trySet(ctl, 'bgColor', st.bg) end
  if st.align then trySet(ctl, 'horizontalAlignment', st.align) end
  if st.valign then trySet(ctl, 'verticalAlignment', st.valign) end
end

-- 能力探测（**正向**判据）：image 类才有 imageColor 字段，cursor 类才有 AddCursorEventListener。
-- 为什么不再用「有没有 AddCursorEventListener」当反向判据：真机上该方法可能是通用桩
-- （2026-10-29 实测：三个候选全部被这条判据判成 cursor ⇒ cell 探测失败、OnStart 直接 error）。
local function capOf(ctl)
  local image, cursor, text = false, false, false
  if not ctl then return image, cursor, text end
  pcall(function() if ctl.imageColor ~= nil then image = true end end)
  pcall(function() if type(ctl.AddCursorEventListener) == 'function' then cursor = true end end)
  pcall(function() if ctl.text ~= nil then text = true end end)
  return image, cursor, text
end

local function accept(ctl, needCursor)
  local image, cursor = capOf(ctl)
  if needCursor then return cursor and (not image) end
  return image
end

-- 按候选 guid 探测模板；候选全灭时**扫一段 GUID**（真机导入后模板会被重编号，写死/候选表都可能过期）
local function probeTemplate(candidates, needCursor)
  local tag = needCursor and 'hit' or 'cell'
  for _, g in ipairs(candidates) do
    if type(g) == 'number' then
      local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return game.InstantiateClientUIControl(g, rootOf()) end)
      if ok and ctl then
        if accept(ctl, needCursor) then
          print('probe ' .. tag .. ' ok guid=' .. tostring(g))
          return ctl, g
        end
        local image, cursor, text = capOf(ctl)
        print('probe ' .. tag .. ' reject guid=' .. tostring(g) .. ' image=' .. tostring(image)
          .. ' cursor=' .. tostring(cursor) .. ' text=' .. tostring(text))
        pcall(function() game.DestroyClientUIControl(ctl) end)
      else
        print('probe ' .. tag .. ' fail guid=' .. tostring(g) .. ' :: ' .. tostring(ctl))
      end
    end
  end
  -- 兜底扫描：地图里所有可能的控件模板段（真机 1073741825.. 与导入段 1073742100..）
  local ranges = { { 1073741825, 1073741999 }, { 1073742100, 1073742160 } }
  local tried = 0
  for _, rg in ipairs(ranges) do
    for g = rg[1], rg[2] do
      local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return game.InstantiateClientUIControl(g, rootOf()) end)
      tried = tried + 1
      if ok and ctl then
        if accept(ctl, needCursor) then
          print('probe ' .. tag .. ' scan ok guid=' .. tostring(g) .. ' tried=' .. tried)
          return ctl, g
        end
        pcall(function() game.DestroyClientUIControl(ctl) end)
      end
    end
  end
  print('probe ' .. tag .. ' GIVE UP tried=' .. tried)
  return nil, nil
end

local function instInto(candidates, parent, needCursor)
  for _, g in ipairs(candidates) do
    local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return game.InstantiateClientUIControl(g, parent) end)
    if ok and ctl then
      if needCursor == nil then return ctl end
      local okFn, fn = pcall(function() return ctl.AddCursorEventListener end)
      if (okFn and type(fn) == 'function') == needCursor then return ctl end
      pcall(function() game.DestroyClientUIControl(ctl) end)
    end
  end
  return nil
end

local function findIn(node, names)
  if not node then return nil end
  for _, n in ipairs(names) do
    local ok, child = pcall(function() return node:GetChild(n) end)
    if ok and child then return child end
  end
  return nil
end

  return {
    noteFail = noteFail, trySet = trySet, tryCall = tryCall, addCursor = addCursor,
    find = find, setText = setText, applyStyle = applyStyle,
    probeTemplate = probeTemplate, instInto = instInto, findIn = findIn, capOf = capOf,
  }
end

return M
